question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: MINDFULNESS
solution:
The correct answer is: **2 i.e. Awareness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mindfulness"** refers to the state of being conscious or aware of something, especially focusing one's awareness on the present moment. It often involves acceptance and paying attention to thoughts and feelings without judgment. (सचेतता)
 
 
• **Example:** Practicing mindfulness can help reduce stress and improve focus.
 
 
• The synonym for **"Mindfulness"** is **"Awareness"**, which means having knowledge or perception of a situation or fact. (जागरूकता)
 
 
• **Example:** Increased awareness of environmental issues has led to more sustainable practices.
 
 
• Hence, the word **"Awareness"** best matches the meaning of **"Mindfulness."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **2 i.e. Awareness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Distraction** (विक्षेप): Something that diverts attention from the main focus.
 
 
• **Example:** Social media is often a major distraction for students during study time.
 
 
 
• **Chaos** (अराजकता): A state of complete disorder and confusion.
 
 
• **Example:** The sudden power outage caused chaos in the office.
 
 
 
• **Negligence** (लापरवाही): Failure to take proper care in doing something.
 
 
• **Example:** His negligence in handling the machine led to an accident.
